reply.text:
Dropping two weight classes in a week isn't something I'll plan. Cutting that much that fast means cutting water and food, and that gets unsafe quickly. No action from me on this one. Please talk it through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can look at your actual numbers and the rules of your sport.

If the weigh-in can be moved or the class changed, that's the safer conversation to have with your coach or the event organizer. Once you've talked to a doctor, I'm glad to help with the training side, including keeping your strength up through whatever timeline they clear.
